name: Feishu Notifier
description: Push mail alerts to a Feishu custom-bot webhook
author: MailFlow community
readme:
# Feishu Notifier

Registers the notifier component id `feishu`. Options: `webhook_url`, optional `secret` (sign), `timeout_seconds`. Sends a text message with the mail summary.
